{{Top|leg}}
The '''Twenty-nine Atoan gods''' were [[God/Legends|deities]] worshipped by the [[Atoan]]s<ref name="TLC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref>, a [[Near-Human]] species from the [[Atoan system]] in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]]<ref name="TLC1">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 1|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 1]]</ref>. The Atoan leader by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[priestess/Legends|High Priestess]] [[Saro|Lady Saro]], [[Prayer/Legends|prayed]] to the Atoan gods for guidance and help, and demonstrated supernatural powers connected to her faith: she could read the minds of the people around her, and project illusions.<ref name="TLC5">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 5|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 5]]</ref> Through a [[Cannibalism|cannibalistic]] ritual she managed to learn [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] in a week: the ritual consisted in eating the tongue of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], who did not survive.<ref name="TLC2" />
